convergence_review.source_rule: Adapt calibration/budget_review.py criteria to the verified interval archives without fabricating standard-search manifests.
convergence_review.earliest_suggestion_to_final_extension_t: HVgain/4 strictly below0.0025, full-front L-infinity distance at most0.01 and extrema drift at most0.005; missing suggestion fails this gate.
convergence_review.shared_baseline_guard: Each seed must contain a feasible nonbaseline trial strictly dominating the shared generalized baseline; the baseline must be absent from each final front.
convergence_review.next_budget_experiment: No automatic extension beyond512. Review progress and failures before declaring any further calibration-only budget experiment.
convergence_review.qualification: Distinct random seeds share initialization, observations and assumptions. Agreement, when present, is descriptive evidence about this fixed search; it does not prove global convergence, parameter identification or predictive validity.
